objectives.description: Create events-log-lifecycle.sh branching on agent_id presence (SubagentStop vs Stop)
SubagentStop path: .postflight-pending marker correlation; Stop path: workflow-active marker + message-pattern fallback, session_id resolved via state.json
bash -n verify; test marker-present SubagentStop, workflow-active Stop, message-pattern fallback, and no-correlation cases

deviations.description: Stop path: emit --event-type session_stop with task omitted when no session_id can be resolved
deviations.reason: events-append.sh requires --session as mandatory; neither workflow-active nor the last_assistant_message fallback carries a session_id directly. Added a session_id lookup via the recovered task number against state.json's active_projects[].session_id (populated by update-task-status.sh on every preflight). When no task is recovered, or the task's session_id cannot be resolved, the hook exits {} cleanly instead of emitting a sessionless event (which events-append.sh would reject anyway).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — session_id for the Stop path resolved via state.json lookup keyed on the recovered task number)*
